description:
Elderly people with nowhere to go began reclaiming a remote mountain village and forming a small community, calling it Saedongne! One day, the entire Saedongne area was swept up in a new city redevelopment project, and with the influx of corrupt forces, the elders finally stepped forward to warn the village, for the sake of peace and survival... "Don't touch a sleeping lion's nose!"

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=817752), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=10278317)
